class StageReport:
    """What one transform did, and why."""

    name: str
    before: GraphStats
    after: GraphStats
    edges_removed: int = 0
    edges_added: int = 0
    nodes_removed: int = 0
    nodes_added: int = 0
    reasons: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    params: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def summary_line(self) -> str:
        delta_n = self.after.n_nodes - self.before.n_nodes
        delta_e = self.after.n_edges - self.before.n_edges
        reasons = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(self.reasons.items())) or "-"
        return (
            f"  {self.name:<26} nodes {self.before.n_nodes:>7} -> {self.after.n_nodes:>7} "
            f"({delta_n:+d})  edges {self.before.n_edges:>7} -> {self.after.n_edges:>7} "
            f"({delta_e:+d})  forks {self.before.n_forks:>5} -> {self.after.n_forks:>5}  [{reasons}]"
        )

    def to_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "before": self.before.to_json(),
            "after": self.after.to_json(),

class NodeImageTable:
    """Per-node image measurements for one movie, and their neighbour-relative forms.

    Indexed by graph row position throughout. ``rel_*`` are natural logs of the ratio to
    the median of the six nearest detections in the same frame, so 0 means "ordinary for
    this neighbourhood" and the units are comparable across movies, depths and frames.
    """

    peak: np.ndarray
    contrast: np.ndarray
    dog_max: np.ndarray
    dog_scale: np.ndarray
    rel_peak: np.ndarray
    rel_contrast: np.ndarray
    rel_dog_max: np.ndarray
    rel_dog_scale: np.ndarray
    density_um: np.ndarray

    def to_npz(self) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
        return {
            "peak": self.peak, "contrast": self.contrast, "dog_max": self.dog_max,
            "dog_scale": self.dog_scale, "rel_peak": self.rel_peak,
            "rel_contrast": self.rel_contrast, "rel_dog_max": self.rel_dog_max,
            "rel_dog_scale": self.rel_dog_scale, "density_um": self.density_um,
        }

def configure_paths(repo_root: Path) -> None:
    """Re-point every read-only input at an explicit repository.

    Needed because worker-q may run this from a work directory rather than from the
    repository itself: ``__file__`` then resolves to a snapshot whose gitignored
    subtrees (``runs/cache``, ``data/train``) are absent or empty. Reading through an
    absolute path is explicitly allowed; only *writes* have to stay relative or be
    passed as an absolute ``--out``.
    """
    global MANIFEST_PATH, DETECT_CACHE, TEACHER_DIR, DATA_ROOT
    root = Path(repo_root).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise SystemExit(f"--repo-root {root} is not a directory")
    MANIFEST_PATH = root / "artifacts" / "manifests" / "datasets.json"
    DETECT_CACHE = root / "runs" / "cache" / "detect"
    TEACHER_DIR = root / "data" / "dense_labels"
    DATA_ROOT = root / "data"

def _load_manifests(fold_id: str | None = None) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any] | None]:
    datasets = load_manifest(MANIFEST_DIR / "datasets.json")
    fold = load_manifest(MANIFEST_DIR / "folds" / f"{fold_id}.json") if fold_id else None
    return datasets, fold

def test_runtime_evidence_output_is_create_only_and_exactly_idempotent(tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "runtime.json"
    payload = {"kind": "runtime_representativeness", "status": "PASS"}
    rr._write_exact_json(out, payload)
    before = out.read_bytes()
    rr._write_exact_json(out, json.loads(before))
    assert out.read_bytes() == before

    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError, match="refusing to replace different"):
        rr._write_exact_json(out, {**payload, "status": "FAIL_RUNTIME"})
    assert out.read_bytes() == before
